A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the performance of a 3D key point detector and descriptor pair is highly dependent on the type of transformations that need to be recovered.
ISS/SHOT and the FPFH detector/descriptor perform best at 3-D recovery under all transformations.
the ISS/Shot detector/descriptor is best suited for 3D recovery of real objects.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a good 3D descriptor is not necessarily a good 2D one and vice versa.

the performance of 3D keypoints and descriptors is highly dependent on the type of transformation applied and that the performance of each detector/descriptor combination varies greatly under different transformations.
the choice of a keypoint detector and descriptor pair should be made based on their overall performance in the application at hand, and not only on their individual performance.
